capabilities: execute Python code inside the editor
extras: README is minimal; it only states the Enter-key execution feature and that it is based on Brython 3.13, with no usage details.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to run Python code inside the editor without switching to an external tool.
summary: Python code runner that executes Python code directly in the editor when you press the Enter key, based on Brython 3.13.
